  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  November 10, 2021

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on November 10, 2021 at 2:01 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works
  Jazmine Covington, Emergency Services Department
  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meetings held on November 10, 2021.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Alexis Coleman DBA Urban Scholar Academy to host a Champion Live Here
  Thanksgiving Giveaway Event at 8473 S. Van Ness Ave; Subject to Approval;
  Applicant to hire (2) Traffic Control Officers ensure the safety of pedestrian and
  vehicular circulation; Applicant shall ensure and have adequate security for safety
  of patrons and to assist with potential crowd control; Applicant to adhere to Public
  Works Encroachment Permit Guidelines; Person directing traffic is required to wear-
  highly-visible retro-reflective vest; Applicant is to adhere to Public Works conditions
  in permitting requirements, and approved plans; Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00321742)

Item #2:  Autry Harris DBA The Sirrah Foundation to host a Thanksgiving Dinner Giveaway
  Food Boxes Event at 100 E. Nutwood St.; Subject to Approval; Applicant to submit
  a revised map that shows the event setup (2) traffic control officers for street
  closures; Adequate security for safety of patrons and to assist IPD with potential
